column1: # A container's layout, read by the emitter. Nothing here is compiled in.
# The emitter knows the shape of the work: read a pattern's tables, put the code and the attributes in, lay the
# sections out again. It knows no offset, no width, no tag and no name. Those are here, and a container of another
# shape is another file of these rows.

column4: <width>     a place in a header, in bytes

column3: <value>                 a number the format gives a meaning
<text>                  a name the format defines, with {part} standing for the part's own

column1: # container kernel <name>               the kernel the container the system accepted enters at

# this one is the ELF64 a CUDA toolchain writes, read off cubins it built
